content:
Seek approval to the acceptance
of grant funding of £651,927 from the Ministry of Housing,
Communities and Local Government (MHCLG) to fund land remediation
and small infrastructure works to facilitate housing development at
Sussex Grove, Parr.
 


     
I.       
Authorise the acceptance of grant from the Ministry of Housing,
Communities and Local Government of £651,927 to facilitate
the delivery of housing at Sussex Grove, Parr; and
 

   
II.       
Authorise the Section 151 Officer of the Council to enter into a
Grant Funding Agreement to facilitate the acceptance of this grant
award.
 

This proposal will secure additional funding
for the Council to address land remediation issues and to remove
barriers to delivering housing on this local authority owned
site.
 
The Council has previously made two successful
bids to the One Public Estate Brownfield Land Release programme,
with funding secured for St Helens Town Centre and Evelyn Avenue
– with both sites progressing to meet the timescales for
delivery required from MHCLG. 
 
The site at Sussex Grove has been vacant for
several years due to the existing challenges in relation to site
conditions. This funding offers the opportunity to
‘unlock’ this site to enable the development of a
residential offer to meet local housing needs.

The alternative option would be to decline the
funding offer from MHCLG. This would result in a missed opportunity
to bring forward a vacant brownfield site for housing development
and would result in the current site issues remaining
unresolved.
topline: The Council Leader has decided to accept grant funding for land remediation and infrastructure works to facilitate housing development at Sussex Grove, Parr.

content:
This report seeks urgent
consideration in respect to changes to the financial appraisal of
Phase 1A of the St Helens Town Centre and seeks approval to amend
the contract sum and the grant agreement to ECF. The report also
seeks approval to transfer land on a freehold basis to ECF to
facilitate the residential element of the scheme.
 

(1) 
Approval of the revised financial appraisal for the St Helens Town
Centre Regeneration and associated Phase Contract value of
£71,855,733 for the main works, which represents a change of
£2,130,000 from the value reported to Cabinet on 19 November
2025.;
(2) 
 Approval of the grant funding agreement
of £14,751,604 (contained within the above contract value) to
ECF with respect to the delivery of the residential component of
the Phase 1A programme; and
(3) 
Approval of the transfer of the freehold and permission provided to
enter a deed of surrender of part of the leasehold interest of the
residential development on completion of the St Helens Town Centre
Phase 1A main contract and approval to execute the freehold
transfer and the deed of surrender of part.
 

To delay a decision to the February 2026
Cabinet meeting, this would result in a significant cost escalation
adding significant financial pressure and increased risk to the
delivery programme.
topline: The Council Leader has decided to approve changes to the financial appraisal and grant agreement for Phase 1A of the St Helens Town Centre, amidst concerns of cost escalation and delivery risks.
